acceptance: Leases die with refresh, epoch change, pause and revocation; mandatory security records fail or report instead of passing silently; file audit recovers a torn tail and rotates as one chain; vault replacement is crash-consistent; keychain writes and deletes are verified.

positive.fixture: audit file recovery and one-chain rotation; mandatory audit failure refuses or reports; keychain write and delete verified; fallback hygiene; lease superseded by refresh

negative.fixture: disk full, torn write, sync failure, permission denied, interrupted rename, directory sync failure, corrupted vault file, failed delete, mid-file tampering

security_and_source_permissions: Errors carry no secret or path; a torn audit tail is cut, damage elsewhere refuses to open.
performance_memory_storage: One fsync per mandatory audit record.
known_limitations: The audit tail needs an external head anchor to detect truncation
Disk-full is simulated with failing writers, not a full device
